title: Ping, pong, ping, pong
summary: Two semaphores make two threads take turns.
hints: One semaphore per thread: `can_ping` starts at 1, `can_pong` at 0. The ping thread does `wait(can_ping); print; post(can_pong)` and the pong thread the opposite.
Both threads loop `N` times; pass `N` to them through a global.
